title: Estimator-Aware Selective VLM Benchmark: Annotation Provenance Audit

annotation_rules.rule_1_separation_of_affordance_and_moti: Physical affordance (FIXED, PORTABLE, MOBILE_AGENT) is disentangled from observed instantaneous motion (STATIC, MOVING).
annotation_rules.rule_2_zero_ground_truth_in_inference: No ground truth annotations, Vicon poses, or reference trajectories are visible to the online router or VLM.
annotation_rules.rule_3_adjudication_provenance: All ground truth labels are physically verified (Vicon for TUM, LiDAR odometry for OpenLORIS, millimeter tape measurements for D455).

tum_rgbd.trajectory_groundtruth: Vicon optical motion capture system (8 cameras, 100 Hz, sub-millimeter accuracy)

openloris.trajectory_groundtruth: LiDAR odometry reference trajectory (strictly not optical motion capture)

realsense_d455.trajectory_groundtruth_note: Uncalibrated handheld sensor; zero fabrication enforced (camera trajectory ATE is strictly null)
realsense_d455.relocation_reference: Precision physical steel tape measurements (sigma = 0.02 m) across 52 verified entities
